_comment: Connector manifest for mphinance agents. Pattern adapted from anthropics/financial-services (.mcp.json, Apache-2.0). Secrets are NOT stored here — pull tokens from VaultGuard (Firestore 'secrets'); see AGENTS.md. Entries documenting hosted/OAuth connectors used in Claude Code web sessions carry a 'managed': true note and no local command.

github._note: Repo-scoped GitHub access (PRs, issues, CI). Provided by the Claude Code web environment.

supabase._note: Postgres + edge functions backing screener / dossier data.

interactive-brokers._note: IBKR market data + account/orders. DECISION SUPPORT — Michael confirms every order. No autonomous execution.

google-drive._note: Supernote PDF export sync + article assets. Folder ids in AGENTS.md.

google-calendar._note: Scheduling — primarily the Gemini Android agent (see GEMINI.md).
